```{r profile-header}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Profile header built from front matter: photo, name, role line, and link pills.
m <- rmarkdown::metadata
esc <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(x))
role <- paste(Filter(nzchar, c(m$subtitle %||% "", m$program %||% "")), collapse = " · ")
when <- if (!is.null(m$started)) {
  if (is.null(m$ended) || identical(m$ended, "Current")) paste("since", m$started) else paste(m$started, "to", m$ended)
} else ""
links <- vapply(m$links %||% list(), function(l) sprintf(
  '<a class="plink" href="%s"%s><i class="bi bi-%s"></i>%s</a>',
  esc(l$href), if (grepl("^https?://", l$href)) ' target="_blank" rel="noopener"' else "", esc(l$icon), esc(l$text)
), character(1))
cat(sprintf(
'<style>#title-block-header { display: none; }</style>

<header class="profile-head"><img src="%s" alt="Photo of %s"><div class="profile-id"><h1>%s</h1><p class="role">%s%s</p><div class="plinks">%s</div></div></header>
',
  esc(m$image), esc(m$title), esc(m$title), esc(role), if (nzchar(when)) paste0('<span class="when"> · ', esc(when), '</span>') else "",
  paste(links, collapse = "")
))
```
